prompt: Based only on the supplied time-series evidence, did credit-market stress rise, and did it remain above its starting level at the latest observation? Answer in one sentence of at most 15 words.

evidence.title: Deterministic summary of bundled ALFRED time series
evidence.passage: From 2020-02-28 to 2020-05-01, the Baa corporate-minus-Treasury spread rose from 2.38 to 3.25 after peaking at 4.23; Baa-minus-Aaa dispersion rose from 0.81 to 1.47 after peaking at 1.91; and the NFCI credit subindex rose from -0.77 to -0.12 after peaking at -0.11. Higher values indicate tighter or more stressed credit conditions.
